sns.definition: n a silvery malleable metallic element that resists corrosion; used in many alloys and to coat other metals to prevent corrosion; obtained chiefly from cassiterite where it occurs as tin oxide
sns.translation: abbr. 交感神经系统（Sympathetic Nervous System）；体干神经系统（Somatic Nervous System）

snsd.translation: 少女时代，韩国著名女子团体，由金泰妍、郑秀妍、李顺圭、黄美英、金孝渊、权侑莉、崔秀英、林允儿、徐珠贤9名成员组成。
